text:
maria-partnerships: Quick sync — we have Marketplace GA slot next Wed. Need final checklist for partner onboarding + press embargo. Main items: marketplace listing metadata, SI training, landing page localization, press embargo window, staging cutover. Who owns which?

ken-eng: I can take marketplace listing metadata and SKU/billing mapping. Will upload sample JSON for review by EOD.

tara-marketing: I'll own press embargo and blog timing. Proposed embargo: Tue 07:00 PT, assets to press by Mon 18:00 PT. Need confirmation from legal.

alex-si: I'll coordinate SI enablement — want a 60m webinar + a shorter 30m ops walkthrough. Available Tue/Fri next week. We need a test tenant for demos.

sam-ops: Test tenant slot ready in staging. I need final list of sample tenants (capacity/region/feature flags). I'll add onboarding runbook to /confluence and share link here.

maria-partnerships: @ken-eng add model/instance constraints for HW partners (A100 vs H100) in the listing. We promised vendor logos + verification badge on the page.

ken-eng: Copy. Also need the manifests from HW partner (runtime profile + quantization notes). Can you ping vendor? @alex-si can you collect?

alex-si: Will reach out. Also request SI partners send training roster by Friday so we can schedule the webinar.

yuki-localization: For landing page localization, we can ship EN + JP + DE for GA. Need copy keys by Friday. I'll run translations and produce i18n bundles.

lee-legal: On embargo — confirm we can share press assets Mon 18:00 PT to reporters under NDA. No embargo exceptions for leaks; partners must sign mutual embargo agreement. I'll circulate a short NDA template.

deploy-bot: assets/upload completed: marketplace_metadata_v3.json (sha256: ab12...), hero-creative_v2.zip, press-brief_v1.pdf

tara-marketing: Received, thanks. @lee-legal please send NDA ASAP. @maria-partnerships can you confirm partner logo approvals?

maria-partnerships: Partner logos approved by Brand yesterday. @sam-ops can you stage hero creative in staging slot 7 so we can screenshare during SI webinar?

sam-ops: Will deploy to slot7 in ~30m. Leaving a note in the runbook.

ken-eng: Uploading marketplace sample metadata now:
```
{
  "sku": "redwood-inf-prod-1",
  "instance_types": ["h100","a100"],
  "billing_unit": "token-hour",
  "region_support": ["us-west-2","eu-west-1"],
  "vendor_verified": true
}
```

alex-si: For webinar slides, what's the level — deep integration (SDK + deploy) or ops only? I can draft two decks.

tara-marketing: Ops-focused for SI webinar, keep a technical appendix for partners who want deep dive.

maria-partnerships: Action items:
- @ken-eng finalize metadata + post by EOD (assigned)
- @lee-legal send NDA template (urgent)
- @alex-si collect SI roster + draft webinar (due Fri)
- @yuki-localization provide i18n bundles (due Fri)
- @sam-ops stage creative + test tenants (ASAP)
- @tara-marketing prepare press brief and embargo list (due Mon noon)

Please react with :thumbsup: when you ack. I'll compile into launch playbook after responses.
